text: APL is the brand of Athletic Propulsion Labs, LLC, founded in 2009 in Los Angeles by identical twins Adam and Ryan Goldston; the company says it remains fully independent, owned and operated by its founders.
short: APL (Athletic Propulsion Labs, LLC): founded and owned by Adam and Ryan Goldston.
